facts.title: zucchini and ricotta galette
ingredients: 1/2 cup (8 tablespoons, 113 grams, or 4 ounces), unsalted butter, cold and cut into cubes
1/4 cup (60 grams) sour cream, plain yogurt, or ricotta
1 large or 2 small zucchinis (about 1 pound or 455 grams), sliced into 1/4-inch thick rounds
1 egg yolk beaten with 1 teaspoon water
1 tablespoon basil leaves, thinly sliced (to finish)
facts.cook_time: 30 to 40 minutes active, 2 hours idle prep, 45 minutes to bake
facts.author: Deb Perelman
